notes: v2.1.0 confirms the shared dome radius and anisotropic scale but does not currently include the 12 cassette panel objects.
v2.0.27 contains the experimental 12-sector shell-panel geometry. This layout retains that parent-sector logic and subdivides each large petal into smaller candidate modules.
The old model offsets the cassette surface slightly outside the dome skin to avoid visual z-fighting. This is a rendering offset, not a physical cavity or clearance requirement.

conventions.azimuthZero: model +Z reference is not aligned to geographic north; orientation TBD
conventions.areaMethod: Numerical integration of the ellipsoid surface element for the anisotropically scaled sphere
conventions.panelBoundary: Constant-azimuth meridian edges and constant-theta curved edges

warnings: Model units are not metres. No scale-to-metres calibration was found in the source files.
The radial factor 1.006 and y offset 0.58 are legacy rendering offsets to separate the visible cassette surface from the dome skin; they are not construction clearances.
The v2.0.27 experimental 12-petal panels are divided into 2 columns and 6 courses here. The 144 entries are geometry candidates, not a released bill of materials.
The v2.1.0 baseline shares the dome radius/scales but has no integrated shell-cassette objects. This layout file does not modify the digital-twin HTML.
No mass, material, support spacing, fastener size, wind capacity, snow/ice capacity, fire rating, water rating or service-life value is inferred.
